verification: All 12 scores below were compared line by line with HLTV's event results page (https://www.hltv.org/results?event=8932) read 2026-10-18 ~00:15Z; each row links its own HLTV match page. Map scores are deliberately not republished here (not re-read this session); open the linked match page.

results.note: Rematch of the Day-1 upset: Aurora swept 9z 2-0 — the Day-1 loss did not repeat.

facts.t: Both teams lost their semi-final and play for third place; HLTV and bo3.gg both label it the decider. Motivation is not measurable from any source, so it moves no number.

Rest / workload: Falcons' semi went the distance (1-2 vs BETBOOM, three maps); Aurora's semi was 0-2 vs FURIA (two maps). Maps played in the event so far (series scores summed): Aurora 8, Falcons 8 — Falcons had no Day-3 match.

Head-to-head: HLTV records Falcons 1-0 over Aurora in the past 30 days. bo3.gg's insight text quotes a 75% historical Aurora H2H win rate (25% for Falcons) with no sample size shown. Neither is large enough to move a line.

Maps, last 6 months (bo3.gg table): Aurora — Anubis 76% (17 maps), Mirage 65% (17), Nuke 61% (18), Cache 56% (9). Falcons — Dust2 71% (31), Anubis 70% (10), Nuke 67% (9), Ancient 53% (15). Veto signals: Aurora has banned Ancient 25 times and played it once; Falcons have banned Cache 10 times and never played it. The page's insight text quotes slightly different figures for the same maps (Anubis 77%, Dust2 73%); the table figures are used.
Form: HLTV shows 3 of the last 5 won for each side and ranks Falcons #5, Aurora #6, and names Falcons 'the bookmaker favorite with the best odds'. bo3.gg: last-month win rate Aurora 64%, Falcons 71%.

Caution on bo3.gg's auto-written insights: for this match they describe it as 'the final' and say Falcons are on a two-match winning streak, which does not fit Falcons' 1-2 semi loss. They are not used as inputs.

FURIA have beaten BETBOOM 2-0 three times in 2026 on bo3.gg's head-to-head list (14 Oct, 3 Oct, 13 Jun); HLTV records 2-0 for FURIA in the past 30 days (two meetings). An older meeting, a year ago, went 2-1 to BETBOOM.

Workload: BETBOOM have played 11 maps in 4 days (0-2, then three straight 2-1 wins over PARIVISION, Legacy and Falcons); FURIA have played 7 maps (2-0, 2-1, 2-0). Computed by summing the series scores on the HLTV results page. A real but unquantified fatigue angle for the Bo5.

Maps, last 6 months (bo3.gg table): FURIA — Inferno 71% (14 maps), Nuke 61% (18), Mirage 58% (24), Ancient 45% (11), Anubis 0% (4 maps; banned 22 times). BETBOOM — Dust2 64% (14), Nuke 59% (17), Ancient 55% (11), Anubis 50% (12), and zero Inferno maps (banned 22 times; the page's text says 92% ban rate).

Form: HLTV shows FURIA won 4 of the last 5 and BETBOOM 3 of 5, ranks #4 vs #14. bo3.gg's insight text gives last-month win rates of 62% (FURIA) and 43% (BETBOOM) and calls BETBOOM 'slumping', although BETBOOM have won their last three series.
Bo5 shrinks upsets: the same per-map edge is a larger series edge over five maps than over three. The page shows the per-map win probability implied by the book's series price.

aurora.claim: There was a recent roster change for Aurora.
aurora.verdict: Real but not recent: the rebuild happened 29 June – 8 July 2026 (about 14 weeks before the event). No change is visible between 8 July and the event.

timeline.event: Coach Fabre moved to the inactive roster.
MAJ3R and soulfly moved to the inactive roster.
Jimpphat (from MOUZ) and coach ashhh (ash) join; Liquipedia lists both with a 2026-07-03 join date.
kyxsan (ex-Falcons, benched before the IEM Cologne Major) joins as in-game leader after about two months without play.
Thunderpick's event preview lists the same five (Wicadia, woxic, XANTARES, Jimpphat, kyxsan) and coach ashhh.
bo3.gg match lineup for the 3rd-place decider: XANTARES, woxic, Jimpphat, kyxsan, Wicadia (all starters).

aurora.reading: Two of the five starters (Jimpphat, kyxsan) have played together for about 14 weeks and kyxsan returned from a two-month layoff — a fair 'onboarding' reason Aurora could lose a Day-1 Bo3 to 9z. It is one data point: Aurora then beat 9z 2-0 in the rematch and NIP 2-0, and lost 0-2 to FURIA. Nothing in the sources shows a roster change inside the event.
